Explain the example for choose browser rendering

blocks.text: A single-page app loads a browser shell and lets routes choose its content. React Router framework mode can build this with server rendering turned off.

Use React Router 7 framework mode, the continuation of Remix's framework approach. Save files at the shown app paths. Set ssr:false in react-router.config.ts for this browser-only course. React tooling is required.

blocks.title: Choose browser rendering

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `ssr: false` selects browser rendering for this React Router framework app. Browser loaders still need the client-specific API.

blocks.text: The framework builds an app intended to run its route work in the browser.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: This setting does not turn server-only loaders into browser code. Use clientLoader for browser loading.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Find the ssr setting in the framework config.
